checks.name: Fresh100 Blob/160 aggregate envelope admits actual40 and maximum46 census hops, reserves54, refuses48 before staging
Strategy is explicit and fixed candidate range, weekdays, windows and backend caps cannot widen
Initial preview binds only earliest create, permits exactly one free slot and retains separate provenance
Empty or weekend-only initial preview stops without a visit and cleanup remains available
Move target stays unbound until observed scheduled create; initial availability does not predeclare it
Historical unattributed CREATE receipt permits cleanup but cannot authorize the stronger late-move protocol
Fresh post-create preview selects a different currently free slot even when an earlier hypothetical afternoon is now busy
Deterministic move order honors declaration order and can choose another window on the original date
No different slot stops honestly, consumes its only preview, and exact current visit can be canceled
Unbound move and arbitrary different slot cannot cross the physical transport boundary
Bound move cannot be previewed again, overwritten or sent twice
Freshness expires across quota inspection before POST without permitting replacement
Changed current visit or configuration blocks preview before transport
Malformed, private, stale or foreign-source move response cannot bind a target or be retried
Lost preview ACK consumes the only move check and never admits an alternative
Failed durable move binding poisons the phase before any physical reschedule
Lost reschedule response cannot be sent again or replaced by another preview
Authoritative Save conflict after binding preserves the one target and cannot choose another
Concurrent late previews admit one transport/binding and cannot replace the first target
Latest owner/visit revisions observed after quota still fence the exact bound reschedule
Caller mutations cannot change the declared range or rewrite bound create/move evidence
Legacy paired strategy still binds two slots and never reinterprets a new target as its old pair
